segments.heading: Hook
segments.text: Nobody likes getting things wrong, or wondering where their wrong answers end up. With Recall, you don't have to worry: your answers are saved only on your device. Recall turns your notes into questions, marks every answer, and brings each card back just before you'd forget it.

highlights.target: the "11 cards ready for you" panel

segments.heading: Make questions
segments.text: Start with what you're studying: notes, a photo of a page, or a PDF. Gemini Nano, built into Chrome, turns short notes and photos into questions. PDFs go to Gemini in the cloud. Firebase AI Logic picks the right one for each job.

highlights.phrase: notes, a photo of a page, or a PDF
picks the right one for each job

segments.heading: Fact-check
segments.text: Then a bigger AI in the cloud checks every card against your notes. This one says fifty-nine percent. Your notes say ninety-five. Flagged, with the fix ready.

highlights.phrase: a bigger AI in the cloud

segments.heading: Study
segments.text: Now, study. Answer from memory: your answers are saved only on your device. Type, or just speak, and your voice is written down right there too. Then say how sure you are, and Gemini Nano marks it on the spot.

highlights.target: the line under the answer box
the microphone in the answer box

highlights.phrase: your voice is written down right there
highlights.target: "Listening on this device: your voice never leaves it."
the mark and its "On this device" badge

segments.heading: Self-audit
segments.text: Can a small model mark fairly? Recall checks itself. A doubtful mark goes to the bigger cloud AI before you see it. The more often Nano gets it right, the less it needs to ask.

highlights.phrase: goes to the bigger cloud AI

segments.heading: Talk it through
segments.text: Missed a point? Talk it through with a tutor on your device. Need more? Ask a bigger model, and the conversation moves to the cloud.

highlights.target: the first reply, as it streams
the Ask a bigger model button
the "Cloud" badge on the new reply

segments.heading: The Trap Gauntlet
segments.text: Every day, the Trap Gauntlet turns your mistakes into a game. Nano writes true-or-false traps on your device, while a cloud referee throws out any unfair ones. Confidence counts: being sure earns more, and costs more when you're wrong.

segments.heading: Read aloud
segments.text: Questions can be read aloud too, by Gemini's text-to-speech. In fact, you're listening to it now.

segments.heading: The AI engine page
segments.text: The AI engine page shows where each job runs. Go offline, and marking, the tutor and the Gauntlet keep working on your device; PDFs wait for a connection. And in Private mode, no answer ever goes to the cloud AI.

highlights.target: the list switching to "On this device" / "Waits for a connection"

segments.heading: Close
segments.text: Insights compares how sure you felt with how you actually did, so you study what you only thought you knew. Small, private work on your device; heavy lifting in the cloud. That's Recall.
